programs.name: supsmovie
programs.purpose: Plot SU traces as a PostScript movie by sending their samples to psmovie.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUPSMOVIE - PostScript MOVIE plot of a segy data set

params.name: n2
params.default: computed: ntr if n3 is absent; otherwise ntr/n3
params.description: Traces per frame; ntr comes from the first header or a count of input traces.

params.name: n3
params.default: computed: 1 if n2 is absent; otherwise ntr/n2
params.description: Number of frames; integer division is used.

params.name: d1
params.default: computed: first trace d1, else dt/1000000, else 0.004 for seismic or 1.0 for nonseismic
params.description: Fast-dimension sampling interval.

params.name: d2
params.default: computed: first trace d2 if nonzero, else 1.0
params.description: Slow-dimension sampling interval.

params.name: f1
params.default: computed: first trace f1, else delrt/1000, else 0.0
params.description: First fast-dimension coordinate.

params.name: f2
params.description: First slow-dimension coordinate. A second getpar call overwrites all header-derived defaults with 1.0 when f2 is absent.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print trace-counting and temporary-file information.

params.name: tmpdir
params.default: computed: CWP_TMPDIR environment variable if set, otherwise ""
params.description: Directory for named temporary files; an empty value uses tmpfile.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Header dt is divided in double precision and converted to float; coordinates are passed to psmovie formatted with %f. Output also depends on psmovie. The code appends a slash directly to the CWPBIN environment string, which can invoke undefined behavior, and constructs a command in a fixed-size buffer without bounds checks.
programs.difficulty_reason: The wrapper handles frame dimensions, optional trace buffering, and a subprocess that produces the plot.

test_cases.description: Count traces and make a single-frame movie.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | supsmovie d1=0.004 d2=1 f1=0 f2=1 > movie.ps

test_cases.description: Use explicit frame dimensions and pass a plotting option through to psmovie.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | supsmovie n2=4 n3=2 d1=0.004 d2=2 f1=0 f2=1 verbose=1 > movie.ps

programs.name: supswigb
programs.purpose: Plot SU traces as a bitmapped PostScript wiggle plot using pswigb.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUPSWIGB - PostScript Bit-mapped WIGgle plot of a segy data set

params.name: key
params.description: Trace header field supplying irregular trace positions; depth and coordinate fields use their associated scale headers.

params.name: n2
params.default: computed: first trace ntr if nonzero, otherwise count input traces
params.description: Trace count; takes precedence over the ntr parameter.

params.name: ntr
params.default: computed: first trace ntr if nonzero, otherwise count input traces
params.description: Alias for n2, read only when n2 is absent.

params.name: d1
params.default: computed: first trace d1, else dt/1000000, else 0.004 for seismic or 1.0 for nonseismic
params.description: Fast-dimension sampling interval.

params.name: d2
params.default: computed: first trace d2 if nonzero, else 1.0
params.description: Slow-dimension sampling interval.

params.name: f1
params.default: computed: first trace f1, else delrt/1000, else 0.0
params.description: First fast-dimension coordinate.

params.name: f2
params.default: computed: first trace f2, else tracr, else tracl, else 1.0 for seismic or 0.0 for nonseismic
params.description: First slow-dimension coordinate; the nonseismic fallback differs from the selfdoc.

params.name: style
params.default: seismic
params.description: Plot style; vsp reverses depth positions and sample polarity when key names a depth field.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print trace-counting and temporary-file information.

params.name: tmpdir
params.default: computed: CWP_TMPDIR environment variable if set, otherwise ""
params.description: Directory for named temporary files; an empty value uses tmpfile.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Irregular depth or coordinate positions use double-precision pow(10, scaler), then convert to float and format with %g; dt conversion mixes double and float. The x2 buffer is read without explicitly writing a terminating NUL before use as a string, causing undefined behavior. The code also appends to the CWPBIN environment string and builds command strings without bounds checks. Output depends on pswigb.
programs.difficulty_reason: The wrapper buffers traces, derives irregular positions from scaled headers, and drives a plotting subprocess.

test_cases.description: Plot regularly spaced traces with explicit dimensions and style.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | supswigb n2=8 d1=0.004 d2=2 f1=0 f2=1 style=normal > wigb.ps

test_cases.description: Build irregular positions from trace sequence headers.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | supswigb key=tracl style=seismic verbose=1 > wigb.ps

test_cases.description: Exercise equal header positions and the regular-spacing fallback.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | supswigb key=offset d2=2 f2=1 > wigb.ps
